feature: API Profile Rotation and Multi-Credential Management
description: Unified credential system treating API profiles and Claude accounts interchangeably, with 4 rotation modes (manual, round-robin, usage-based, rate-limit-aware), per-task credential selection, API usage tracking, reactive auto-swap on rate limits, and proactive monitoring.
workflow_rationale: This is a new feature that adds credential rotation and multi-account management to the existing Auto Claude system. It requires new data models, rotation logic, usage tracking infrastructure, and integration with the Claude Agent SDK error handling, but does not refactor existing code.
